description:
[0.98a] Starsector Language Pack - French v2.0.0-rc2

French translation mod for Starsector 0.98a-RC8.

What's translated:

40,000+ lines of dialogue, quests, events (rules.csv)Full Codex (Spacer's Handbook — combat, UI, tech types)Skills, hullmods, weapons, ship systemsFactions, ranks, fleet namesMissions, tooltips, loading tipsShip names, commodities, industries

Known limitations:

Some UI labels remain in English (hardcoded in Java): deployment panel, combat HUD (FLUX, HULL, CR), character creation screen. A detailed report has been sent to Alex.

Download:

GitHub Release v2.0.0-rc2

Installation:

1. Download the ZIP

2. Extract into mods/

3. Enable in launcher

4. New game recommended

Compatibility:

Compatible with any mod that doesn't override the same vanilla data files (rules.csv, descriptions.csv, strings.json). Most gameplay/ship/faction mods work fine.

Feedback & bugs:

GitHub Issues

GitHub Repository

aiDescription: Adds a full French translation for Starsector 0.98a, covering over 40,000 lines of dialogue, quests, events, and in-game text. Translates the Codex, ship systems, weapons, hullmods, factions, ranks, missions, tooltips, and ship names.
